resources.string: Welcome to EARWAX 4.0\nCompletely rebuilt with pure-Python early-2000s 3D liquid chrome, direct YouTube Music streaming, synced lyrics & freeze-proof background playback.
Left Ear Speaker Pod\nSmooth, instant Previous, Play/Pause & Next with zero-click crossfading. All 6 metallic drivers pump live to the beat.
Right Ear Speaker Pod\nMusic Hub / Queue, 10-Band Parametric EQ with live curve, and Studio FX + Keep-Alive Reliability settings.
Levitating Y2K Aqua Crown Orbs\nShuffle, Repeat, Smart Fade Sleep Timer, and 3 Redesigned 3D Floating Popups (Cyber Deck, Sonic Orb, Mini-Pill).
Curved Chrome-Glass Visor\nTap LRC for live synced lyrics, tap album art for 4 visualizers, drag the neon bar to seek, or swipe left/right to skip.
YouTube Music & Local Console\nSearch & stream YouTube Music directly, tap ↓ to save tracks offline, start Auto-Radio mixes, or browse local songs & live radio.
3D Floating Popups & Twin 3D Drawers\nTap the top 3D button on any popup to unfold twin left & right 3D panels: Mini YouTube Music (search & download), Queue, Lyrics & Track Tools.
